description: This file is a Python script that connects to a websocket to stream stock trading data from TradingView, processes incoming messages, and saves the data into a CSV file.

methods.name: filter_raw_message
methods.description: Filters relevant data from websocket messages using regex.

methods.name: generateSession
methods.description: Generates a random session ID with prefix 'qs_'.

methods.name: generateChartSession
methods.description: Generates a random chart session ID with prefix 'cs_'.

methods.name: prependHeader
methods.description: Prepares a message string with a header indicating its length.

methods.name: constructMessage
methods.description: Constructs a JSON message with specified function and parameters.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates a full message with header and JSON payload.

methods.name: sendRawMessage
methods.description: Sends a raw message over the websocket.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message with specified function and arguments over the websocket.

methods.name: generate_csv
methods.description: Extracts data from websocket message and writes it to a CSV file.
